answer: Reference-attestation scarcity. Each identity must cite a distinct island of prior work whose fingerprints an independent auditor can verify, and only citations from disjoint umber-keyed batches count toward the quota. A fresh identity needs a unique violet-tagged contribution record that no existing account has already consumed, so mass registration exhausts the eligible pool. Sybil cost is the labor of producing verifiable, non-duplicate artifacts faster than auditors retire them.
